title: Data architect (data modeling & optimization)
description:
About You
You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
Strong proficiency using Git Hub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.
Additional Information
About Us
At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.
We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.
Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Sales executive - subsea
description:
About M&O PartnersM&O Partners is a multi‑disciplined professional services company providing sales development, strategic and operational services to the energy and maritime industries, with a strong presence in Brazil’s offshore market. From Rio de Janeiro, M&O supports international subsea and offshore technology providers in winning new business with Brazilian operators, EPCIs and contractors through local technical sales expertise and structured sales representation.Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Subsea is responsible for driving M&O Partners’ commercial development within the Brazilian subsea market, with a primary focus on acquiring new customers and opportunities for M&O’s supplier portfolio of subsea equipment, systems and digital solutions.
Reporting directly to the Senior Advisor – Subsea, the Sales Executive - Subsea will proactively identify prospects, open doors at target accounts, progress opportunities through the sales cycle, position M&O’s supplier portfolio and develop new client relationships with offshore operators, subsea contractors, and engineering companies.
The Sales Executive - Subsea will engage with key stakeholders across the Brazilian subsea value chain, providing technical insight and solution‑driven support to ensure client needs are met, supplier value is clearly articulated, and sales objectives are consistently achieved.
Success in this role is measured by new logos, qualified pipeline creation, closed new business and sustained satisfaction across M&O’s subsea supplier portfolio.Key ResponsibilitiesNew Business Hunting & Development
Proactively research, identify and prioritize target accounts in the Brazilian subsea ecosystem, including E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and engineering consultancies.
Execute structured outbound prospecting (calls, emails, Linked In, events) to secure first meetings with decision‑makers and influencers in engineering, operations, and supply chain.
Open and quality new relationships (“new logos”) for M&O in the subsea market, convert leads into commercial opportunities and manage the full sales process from prospecting to contract closure, handing over matured accounts for farming when appropriate.
Expand M&O’s reach among key players in the subsea market, ensuring ongoing engagement and account development.Product & Solution Representation
Develop a strong technical understanding of subsea products and services in the M&O portfolio, including equipment, systems, intervention technologies and software used in subsea operations and integrity management.
Lead initial discovery and capability meetings, presenting supplier solutions and tailoring the value proposition to Brazilian subsea project needs.
Coordinate deeper technical discussions with supplier specialists while maintaining commercial ownership of the opportunity.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier innovations, certifications, and subsea industry standards.Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor Brazilian subsea project pipelines, pre‑salt developments, brownfield tiebacks and intervention campaigns to time outreach and proposals effectively with M&O’s supplier portfolio (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs).
Map competitive offerings and routes‑to‑market, identifying white space and differentiation angles for M&O’s supplier portfolio.
Provide structured insights on projects, competitors and customer requirements to the Senior Advisor - Subsea and M&O’s supplier portfolio to refine targeting and positioning.Sales Process & Reporting
Support the development of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives for the subsea market.
Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, logging activities, contacts, opportunities, next steps and realistic pipeline forecasts.
Monitor proper use by M&O’s supplier portfolio in the subsea market of our CRM tool.
Report regularly to the Senior Advisor - Subsea on number of new leads and first meetings, pipeline volume and quality, stage progression and new business closed.Skills and Competencies
Technical Sales Expertise: Proven success in B2 B sales of technical/engineered solutions in subsea, offshore, SURF or related industrial environments.
Client‑Facing Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise value propositions for Brazilian subsea stakeholders at multiple levels.
Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Comfortable navigating Brazilian procurement processes, RFQs and tenders, and supporting commercial negotiations for high‑value contracts.
Analytical & Strategic Thinking: Uses market data and project intelligence to prioritize accounts, design prospecting campaigns and focus on highest‑potential opportunities.
Autonomy & Collaboration: Self‑starter who plans and executes their own hunting activities while closely aligning with the Senior Advisor and the Sales teams.
Language skills: fluent Portuguese and advanced English.Experience Requirements
Minimum 5 years of experience within the subsea industry (ideally serving the Brazilian SURF market) with an active network of professionals.
Minimum 2 years of B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within subsea, offshore or engineered equipment sectors.
Demonstrated track record in outbound prospecting, generating new business and closing new accounts (not only managing existing ones).
Experience engaging with E&P operators, subsea contractors, EPCIs and intervention/service companies in Brazil.
Solid understanding of project‑driven, longer‑cycle sales and formal procurement environments and technical sales environments.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

title: Gerente Sênior De Conteúdo E Engajamento
description:
1. COMO É SER GERENTE (SÊNIOR) DE CONTEÚDO E ENGAJAMENTO EM MSF-BRASIL:

Você irá liderar a equipe de Conteúdo e Engajamento, assegurando o papel estratégico e criativo do time na sensibilização e engajamento do público brasileiro com o trabalho médico-humanitário da organização. Além disso, é responsável por liderar a equipe na produção de conteúdos relevantes para todos os canais e campanhas de MSF-Brasil, implementar estratégias inovadoras para as redes sociais, gerir comunidades e fortalecer o engajamento com públicos prioritários, ampliando o alcance e o impacto das mensagens da organização, potencializando doações e fortalecendo a marca de MSF.

Você também será responsável por garantir a visibilidade constante dos desafios enfrentados pelas populações que atendemos por meio da imprensa brasileira, veículos não tradicionais e influenciadores, maximizando a cobertura das crises e potencializando o papel de Médicos Sem Fronteiras como referência nos temas relacionados à ajuda humanitária.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?
  • Liderar a produção de conteúdo e a gestão das redes sociais e comunidades, respondendo a crises e engajando diferentes públicos de forma inovadora, criativa, ousada e eficiente;
  • Proteger e preservar a imagem de MSF, assegurando que todas as comunicações públicas estejam em conformidade com o posicionamento da marca, os guias de linguagem e as diretrizes visuais da organização;
  • Respeitar e contribuir com a missão social de MSF, dando destaque às crises humanitárias em que a organização atua e considerando o princípio de “témoignage”, ao mesmo tempo em que alavanca com criatividade e autenticidade as ações de comunicação, potencializando o resultado e o impacto das nossas atividades.
3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Produção e gestão de conteúdo

  • Garantir a criação e otimização de conteúdos de marketing voltados para campanhas de captação de pessoas doadoras e recursos;
  • Liderar, em conjunto com o comitê editorial, a definição e implementação do calendário editorial de MSF-Brasil, assegurando coerência nos conteúdos produzidos, alinhamento com os temas prioritários da organização e com maior potencial de engajamento, além de identificar oportunidades para diferentes finalidades e canais;
  • Transformar os posicionamentos de MSF em conteúdo e estratégias de comunicação e marketing, amplificando a missão social da organização, evidenciando crises humanitárias esquecidas, violações do direito humanitário e inadequações ou falta de ajuda humanitária;

Gestão de redes sociais e canais digitais proprietários

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias inovadoras para fortalecer a presença e o engajamento nas redes sociais e demais canais digitais proprietários, adaptando as abordagens às particularidades de cada plataforma e garantindo o monitoramento constante para implementação de melhorias e otimização dos resultados;
  • Viabilizar a gestão de comunidades, promovendo interações significativas, fortalecendo o engajamento com o público, convertendo doadores e ampliando o alcance e impacto das mensagens da organização;
  • Garantir o monitoramento e interações nas redes sociais, assegurando respostas alinhadas ao tom da marca e às diretrizes específicas, além da gestão eficaz e cuidadosa de situações críticas;
  • Assegurar o monitoramento das redes sociais e canais proprietários de MSF para identificar tendências, menções, sentimento e possíveis crises, analisando dados dos canais de comunicação e feedbacks do público para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;

Gestão de influenciadores e relacionamento com a imprensa

  • Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia de influenciadores com objetivo de ampliar o alcance e melhorar o engajamento do público com a organização;
  • Assegurar a visibilidade constante dos desafios enfrentados pelas populações que atendemos por meio da imprensa brasileira e de diferentes agentes de influência, maximizando a cobertura das crises humanitárias;
  • Viabilizar a preparação dos porta-vozes, aprimorando suas habilidades de comunicar com clareza, assertividade e alinhamento estratégico, a fim de garantir uma mensagem eficaz e impactante;

Comunicação integrada e gestão de reputação

  • Liderar e fortalecer a comunicação institucional e a comunicação operacional dos projetos no Brasil;
  • Gerenciar a criação, produção, adaptação e revisão dos conteúdos que atendam às necessidades institucionais, operacionais e sazonais para diferentes canais e objetivos;
  • Potencializar engajamento com o público interno, apoiando objetivos institucionais e impulsionando o papel destes grupos como embaixadores de marca e conteúdo;
  • Proteger e preservar a imagem de MSF, assegurando que todas as comunicações públicas estejam em conformidade com o posicionamento da marca, os guias de linguagem e as diretrizes visuais da organização;
  • Identificar riscos e propor ações de mitigação para crises reputacionais, tanto institucionais quanto operacionais, desenvolvendo conteúdos específicos, como reactive lines e Q&A, além de garantir o monitoramento e a gestão cuidadosa das interações relacionadas à crise nas redes sociais;

Integração e colaboração com outras células e demais áreas

  • Colaborar com outras áreas de MSF, como Advocacy, Unidade Médica, entre outros, em campanha e ações, garantindo adequação e acuracidade dos conteúdos produzidos e o alinhamento com a missão social da organização;
  • Trabalhar com as lideranças de crescimento e BI para avaliar resultado das campanhas e ações, e disseminar aprendizado junto à equipe.

Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança

  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, incentivando ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Estimular a criatividade e a experimentação, propondo soluções inovadoras e ousadas que ampliem a relevância e o engajamento de MSF-Brasil junto ao público brasileiro;
  • Basear decisõesem dados e evidências, fortalecendo a transparência, a eficiência e o foco em resultados;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança no processo de transformação da área, contribuindo para a implementação de novas formas de trabalhar, incluindo cultura data-driven e metodologia ágil.
4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?
  • Graduação completa;

  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights

Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in the online travel or e-commerce industry

  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status. Responsibilities Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs) Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals Required Experience Excellent written and verbal English communication skills University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent Preferred Experience Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems Experience with Atlassian/Jira Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows: REST APIs (in Postman) JavaScript basics (any programming language) Basic SQL commands Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog Experience using project management tools, such as Jira Additional Information Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with innovative and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP Core Client Values The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture. Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses. About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Architect
description: About You You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential. Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora. Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development. Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance. Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance. Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation. Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance. Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora. Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies. Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions. Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads. Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers. Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments. Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective. Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies. Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams. Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses. Additional Information About Us At Applaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research. The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities. Main Responsibilities · Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators. · Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings. · Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets. · Track the performance and movements of financial assets. · Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts. · Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis. · Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials. · Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications. Requirements · Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory). · Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields. · Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments. · Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports. · Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail. · Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling). · Clear and structured written communication skills. · Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events. Differentials · Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets. · Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters. · Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI). Benefits · Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market. · Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm. · Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development. · Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu. Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Landscape helps manage policy, compliance, patch management, and access control across large estates.

We have a system that serves thousands of deployments, and we want to give it a fresh vision. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills. You will work closely with product managers and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. You will grow a team of engineers, collaborate with other engineering and business teams, and provide periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage, helping them grow as engineers.

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region

  • Work from home with global travel 4–6 weeks per year for internal and external events
Valued Skills and Experience
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it

What We Offer

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

This global leadership role in cyber security is to manage the Security Operations (SecOps) team responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

As a leader on cyber security in the company, the SecOps team manager will collaborate with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate SecOps training across Canonical. They will operate in a wider security organisation, run a high performing security team and improve Canonical's security posture. They will lead initiatives to integrate the team's insights into Canonical's broader software development process.

While this is a management position, we expect managers to be expert practitioners, able to lead by example, contribute at the highest level, and assess work based on their own professional experience and skill. Candidates should have deep, hands-on expertise with a range of open source and proprietary security tooling and practices, which they can integrate into a holistic next generation security solution across the breadth of Canonical's interests.

The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

This role reports to the CISO.

What you will do in this role:

  • Hire and mentor a team of outstanding technical security professionals
  • Define Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Own and drive the architecture and design of the SOC
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • Proven track record of mitigating with advanced threat actors and nation state threats
  • Expert technical understanding of SOCs from the ground up
  • In depth knowledge of SOC architecture and design including strategies for logging, firewalls, network segmentation, honeypots etc
  • Someone who understands how the SOC works not just how to use it
  • Expert in Linux security
  • Ability to define, implement, automate and measure effective incident response playbooks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Confidence to report security performance metrics with accountability for accuracy and completeness

Optional things we value

  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with open source security tools
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
  • Experience with security posture management of corporate endpoitns

A Ortobom iniciou suas atividades em 1969, fabricando camas e mesas de metal. Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.

A Aegea Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos.   • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura.   • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.

Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.
